name: LoFi Keys
description: Lo-fi piano with vintage character and tape saturation - velocity layered
author: Zenith DAW

regions.comment: Soft velocity layer - C3 sample covering F#2-F3
Soft velocity layer - C4 sample covering F#3-F4
Soft velocity layer - C5 sample covering F#4-C6
Hard velocity layer - C3 sample covering F#2-F3
Hard velocity layer - C4 sample covering F#3-F4
Hard velocity layer - C5 sample covering F#4-C6

notes.usage: This demonstrates velocity layering - same notes mapped to different samples based on MIDI velocity (0-63 = soft, 64-127 = hard)
notes.keyRanges: Each sample covers ~12 notes (one octave) to minimize CPU usage while maintaining good quality
notes.loopMode: forward loop allows sustain pedal to work naturally
notes.character: Increase the 'character' parameter for more vintage tape saturation
